title: Event A6 (Neighbour becomes offset better than SCell)

entities.name: Event A6
entities.description: Measurement event triggered when a neighbour cell becomes offset better than the serving cell (SCell).

entities.name: UE
entities.description: User Equipment that performs measurement and triggers Event A6.

entities.name: Neighbour Cell
entities.description: Adjacent cell measured by the UE for comparison with SCell.

entities.name: SCell
entities.description: Serving Cell used as reference for Event A6 measurement comparison.

relations.description: UE triggers Event A6 based on measurement conditions.
Event A6 condition involves neighbour cell measurement becoming offset better than SCell.
Event A6 condition uses SCell as the reference for comparison with neighbour cell.
